bib.title: Rethinking with Retrieval: Faithful Large Language Model Inference

question: Can external knowledge be used with a frozen LLM, with no training, to make chain-of-thought explanations more faithful and predictions more accurate?
hypothesis: Retrieving knowledge for each decomposed CoT reasoning step and choosing the prediction best supported by it will beat CoT and self-consistency.
contributions: Rethinking with retrieval (RR), a training-free post-processing method that retrieves per reasoning step and picks the best-supported prediction
Experiments on commonsense, temporal and tabular reasoning with GPT-3
Two variants (fact selection, fact generation) that improve explanation faithfulness

method.summary: Sample N CoT reasoning paths from GPT-3, retrieve knowledge for each explanation sentence from a task-specific knowledge base, score each path's faithfulness with an NLI/similarity function f_KB, and return the prediction with the highest summed faithfulness over paths. No training or fine-tuning.
method.task: Complex reasoning (StrategyQA commonsense, TempQuestions temporal, INFOTABS tabular) with retrieval-augmented CoT

datasets.name: StrategyQA
datasets.preprocessing: Test annotations not public so dev used

datasets.name: TempQuestions (implicit temporal, single answer)
datasets.size: 1,271 questions total; 175 implicit single-answer; first 6 for prompting, 169 for evaluation
datasets.source: Jia et al., 2018; answers from Freebase
datasets.preprocessing: Filtered to implicit temporal questions with a single answer

datasets.name: INFOTABS
datasets.size: 23,738 hypotheses over 2,540 Wikipedia info-boxes; dev 1,800 hypotheses on 200 tables
datasets.split: 1,200 entailed/contradicted dev hypotheses (equal split) on 200 tables
datasets.preprocessing: Neutral hypotheses dropped; tables converted to text as in Varun et al., 2022

other.use: selects most similar paragraph by cosine similarity
final inference from supporting facts in Variants I and II

inference.decoding: sampling for RR and self-consistency; greedy-like temperature 0 for zero/few-shot and CoT
inference.samples: 10 sampled outputs per question for self-consistency and RR (9 for StrategyQA); single run, no seeds reported
inference.prompting: StrategyQA: CoT prompt from Wei et al. 2022; temporal: 6-exemplar CoT prompt (Table 6); tabular: NLI converted to QA, 6 random training exemplars (Table 8); few-shot uses same exemplars without CoT
inference.retrieval: StrategyQA: BM25 (Pyserini, Karpukhin et al. re-implementation) top 10 Wikipedia paragraphs per explanation sentence, then MPNet picks most similar. Temporal: spaCy entity linker to Wikidata, temporal relations templated into sentences. Tabular: WordNet and ConceptNet triples linking premise and hypothesis words (Varun et al. 2022) plus table text.

other.cost: compute, API cost and latency not reported
other.fact generation tools: Deutsch et al. 2021 question generator, ktrapeznikov/albert-xlarge-v2-squad-v2 filter, MarkS/bart-base-qa2d

metrics.name: Exact match
metrics.definition: as defined in Rajpurkar et al. 2016, temporal reasoning

metrics.name: Faithfulness (factuality)
metrics.definition: NLI-based factual consistency of explanation with evidence, using Nie et al. 2020 NLI model instead of fine-tuned T5-11B

eval.protocol: Single run per method on dev sets; no variance or significance tests reported.

prompts.text:
Q: who was governor of oregon when shanghai noon was released?
A: Shanghai Noon was released on May 26, 2000. John Kitzhaber served as the 35th governor of Oregon from 1995 to 2003. Thus, John Kitzhaber was governor of oregon when shanghai noon was released. So the answer is John Kitzhaber.

The Region of Curitiba are South. The Elevation of Curitiba are 934.6 m (3,066.3 ft). ... Question: Curitiba is above sea level. True or False?
Answer: The elevation of Curitiba are 934.6 m (3,066.3 ft). Elevation is a hypernym of level. Thus, Curitiba is above sea level. So the answer is true.

limits: Only three reasoning tasks, one frozen model family (GPT-3 text-davinci-002) plus OPT in a size study.
Gains are small on INFOTABS (+0.83 over self-consistency) and no variance, seeds or significance tests are reported.
Variant results use gold StrategyQA evidence paragraphs, not retrieved ones, so they are an upper-bound style setting.
Faithfulness is measured with an off-the-shelf NLI model rather than the fine-tuned T5-11B metric.
Thresholds and f_KB form differ per task and were hand-chosen; cost of 10 samples plus per-sentence retrieval and NLI is not reported.
Authors state future work on variations to improve effectiveness and efficiency.
